1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengubahsuaian
Undang-Undang (Rumah Perjudian Terbuka, Loteri, Per-
taruhan, Duti Pertaruhan dan Ambiltagan dan Lumba Kuda
(Lembaga Totalisator)) (Perluasan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan
Sarawak) 1991 dan hendaklah mula berkuatkuasa pada tarikh yang
ditetapkan oleh Menteri, melalui pemberitahuan dalam Warta.

2. Dalam Perintah ini "undang-undang diperluaskan" ertinya Akta
Rumah Perjudian Terbuka 1953, Akta Loteri 1952, Ordinan Per-
taruhan 1953, Akta Duti Pertaruhan dan Ambiltagan 1948 dan Akta
Lumba Kuda (Lembaga Totalisator) 1961 dan semua perundangan
subsidiari yang dibuat di bawah undang-undang tersebut di atas
sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian II Jadual Pertama,
Bahagian Il Jadual Kedua, Bahagian II Jadual Keempat dan
perenggan 10 (2) Perintah ini.

1507                            P.U. (A) 377.

3. Akta Rumah Perjudian Terbuka 1953 diubahsuaikan dengan cara
yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian I Jadual Pertama:

4.. Akta Loteri 1952 diubahsuaikan dengan cara yang dinyatakan
dalam Bahagian I Jadual Kedua.        |

5. Ordinan Pertaruhan 1953 diubahsuaikan dengan cara yang
dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

6. Akta Duti Pertaruhan dan Ambiltagan 1948 diubahsuaikan
dengan cara yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian 1 Jadual Keempat.

7. (1) Akta Rumah Perjudian Terbuka 1953 sebagaimana yang
diubahsuaikan oleh Perintah ini diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah
dan Sarawak.

(2) Semua perundangan subsidiari yang dibuat di bawah Akta
Rumah Perjudian Terbuka 1953 sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
Bahagian II Jadual Pertama diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan
Sarawak.

8. (1) Akta Loteri 1952 sebagaimana yang diubahsuaikan oleh
Perintah ini diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan Sarawak.

(2) Semua perundangan subsidiari yang dibuat di bawah Akta
Loteri 1952 sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian II Jadual
Kedua diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan Sarawak.

9. Ordinan Pertaruhan 1953 sebagaimana yang diubahsuaikan oleh »

Perintah ini diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan Sarawak.

10. (1) Akta Duti Pertaruhan dan Ambiltagan 1948 sebagaimana
yang diubahsuaikan oleh Perintah ini diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri
Sabah dan Sarawak.

(2) Semua perundangan subsidiari yang dibuat di bawah Akta Duti
Pertaruhan dan Ambiltagan 1948 sebagaimana yang dinyatakan
dalam Bahagian II Jadual Keempat diperluaskan ke Negeri-Negeri
Sabah dan Sarawak.

11. (1) Akta Lumba Kuda (Lembaga Totalisator) 1961 diperluaskan
ke Negeri-Negeri Sabah dan Sarawak.

(2) Penetapan yang dibuat oleh Menteri di bawah seksyen 18 Akta
Lumba Kuda (Lembaga Totalisator) 1961 diperluaskan ke Negeri-
Negeri Sabah dan Sarawak.

MALAYSIA ACT

MobpiFICATION OF LAWs (Common GAMING Houses,
LOTTERIES, BETTING, BETTING AND SWEEPSTAKE
Duties AND RACING (TOTALISATOR BOARD))
(EXTENSION TO THE STATES OF SABAH AND
SARAWAK) OrDER 1991

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act,
the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Modification of Laws (Common
Gaming Houses, Lotteries, Betting, Betting and Sweepstake
Duties and Racing (Totalisator Board)) (Extension to the States of
Sabah and Sarawak) Order 1991 and shall come into force on such
date as the Minister may, by notification in the Gazette, appoint.

2. In this Order, "extended laws" means the Common Gaming
Houses Act 1953, the Lotteries Act 1952, the Betting Ordinance 1953,
the Betting and Sweepstake Duties Act 1948 and the Racing
(Totalisator Board) Act 1961 and all subsidiary legislation made
under the above-mentioned laws as specified in Part II of the First
Schedule, Part II or the Second Schedule, Part Il of the Fourth
Schedule and paragraph 10 (2) of this Order.

3. The Common Gaming Houses Act 1953 is modified in the manner
set out in Part I of the First Schedule.

4. The Lotteries Act 1952 is modified in the manner set out in Part
I of the Second Schedule.

5. The Betting Ordinance 1953 is modified in the manner set out in
the Third Schedule.

6. The Betting and Sweepstake Duties Act 1948 is modified in the
manner set out in Part 1 of the Fourth Schedule.

7. (1) The Common Gaming Houses Act 1953 as modified by this
Order is extended to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

(2) All subsidiary legislation made under the Common Gaming
Houses Act 1953 as specified in Part II of the First Schedule are
extended to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

8. (1) The Lotteries Act 1952 as modified by this Order is extended
to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

(2) The subsidiary legislation made under the Lotteries Act 1952
as specified in Part Il of the Second Schedule are extended to the
States of Sabah and Sarawak.

9. The Betting Ordinance 1953 as modified by this Order is extended
to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

1513                                P.U. (A) 377.

10. (1) The Betting and Sweepstake Duties Act 1948 as modified by
this Order is extended to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

(2) The subsidiary legislation made under the Betting and Sweep-
stake Duties Act 1948 as specified in Part II of the Fourth Schedule are
extended to the States of Sabah and Sarawak.

11. (1) The Racing (Totalisator Board) Act 1961 is extended to the
States of Sabah and Sarawak.

(2) The declaration made by the Minister under section 18 of the
Racing (Totalisator Board) Act 1961 is extended to the States of Sabah
and Sarawak.

12. (1) The laws set out in the Fifth Schedule are repealed:

Provided that any exemption, permit or licence issued or granted
under the Gaming Ordinance Sabah or the Gambling Ordinance,
Sarawak on or before the commencement of this Order, shall continue
to remain in full force and effect under the respective Ordinances
under which it was made, and shall continue in force until it expires,
or is varied, amended or revoked under the said laws. For these
purposes only, the respective Ordinances shall continue to be in full
force and effect.

(2) For the purpose of paragraph 12 (1) above, the Gaming
Ordinance, Sabah is modified in the manner set out in the Sixth
Schedule.

(3) Any proceeding pending or existing before any Court imme-
diately before the coming in force of this Order, shall be continued
under the repealed laws as if this Order had not been made.
